findings.highlight: Nothing’s wrong, and there’s no sign of danger
findings.evidenceJa: 何がおかしい訳でもなく、何か危険なモノが混ざっているのでもない
findings.governingReading: Nothing is concretely wrong, nor has any dangerous thing mixed into the house.
findings.explanation: The English compresses the distinction between an observable anomaly and a dangerous presence into generic signs of danger.

findings.highlight: I have a bad feeling
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌な予感が背中を掠めた
findings.governingReading: A vague premonition brushes across Shirou’s back.
findings.explanation: The English preserves foreboding but removes its fleeting bodily image.

findings.highlight: Illya is sleeping in her room
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは和室で眠っている
findings.governingReading: Illya is sleeping in the Japanese-style tatami room.
findings.explanation: The English invents a personal room and loses household geography.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is preparing for the projection in her room
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は客間で投影の準備をしている
findings.governingReading: Rin is preparing for Projection in a guest room.
findings.explanation: The English turns temporary guest accommodation into Rin’s own room.

findings.highlight: my uneasiness
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌な予感、何か欠けている、という虫の報せ
findings.governingReading: Shirou suppresses a premonitory intuition that something is missing.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the specific warning and perceived absence to generic uneasiness.

findings.highlight: her figure disappears
findings.evidenceJa: 幻のように掻き消えた
findings.governingReading: Rider vanishes as though she were an illusion.
findings.explanation: The English removes the simile and abrupt erasure image.

findings.highlight: Rider has been glaring at me until now
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまでライダーに睨まれていた
findings.governingReading: Rider had been watching Rin until shortly before Shirou arrived.
findings.explanation: The English extends Rider’s watch through the present moment despite her disappearance.

findings.highlight: cold disinterest, as if she’s given up on something
findings.evidenceJa: 何かを諦めて容認したような、そんな冷たさ
findings.governingReading: Rin’s level voice has the coldness of someone who has resigned herself to and accepted an unwelcome outcome.
findings.explanation: The English turns painful acceptance into lack of interest.

findings.highlight: She was gone before you left
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が出て行く前から居なかったようだから
findings.governingReading: Rin says Sakura appears already to have been absent before Shirou left.
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin’s evidential qualification and makes the chronology certain.

findings.highlight: it’s already been two hours
findings.evidenceJa: もう二時間は経つ
findings.governingReading: At least two hours have elapsed since Sakura’s inferred departure.
findings.explanation: The English drops the lower-bound force and reads as an exact duration.

findings.highlight: I can’t say for certain
findings.evidenceJa: あるものか、とは言えなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot finish declaring that Sakura could not possibly be hiding something.
findings.explanation: The English weakens a failed categorical denial into ordinary uncertainty.

findings.highlight: So she must be hungry
findings.evidenceJa: きっと空腹なのよ、あの子
findings.governingReading: Rin concludes accusatorily that “that child,” Sakura, must be hungry.
findings.explanation: The English omits the distancing yet familial way Rin refers to Sakura.

findings.highlight: Her eyes say to give up, telling me it’s all over
findings.evidenceJa: “もういいでしょう、士郎”と、一つの終わりを訴えていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou reads Rin’s eyes as appealing, “That is enough now, Shirou,” and urging one particular ending.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the quoted appeal with two broader declarations of surrender and finality.

findings.highlight: I’ll argue with you as long as you like
findings.evidenceJa: 納得いくまで言い合ってやる
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he will argue the matter after Sakura returns until he himself is satisfied.
findings.explanation: The English gives Rin control over the argument’s desired duration.

findings.highlight: Someone unexpected calls to me
findings.evidenceJa: 予想外の声がかけられた
findings.governingReading: An unexpected voice addresses Shirou from behind.
findings.explanation: The English prematurely characterizes the person as unexpected rather than the voice’s occurrence.

findings.highlight: As a Holy Grail, Illya must understand what condition Sakura is in
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ聖杯だからこそ、イリヤには桜がどんな状態なのか感じ取れるのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Illya can sense Sakura’s state because they are both Grail vessels.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his tentative mechanism into established understanding.

findings.highlight: she still chose to end herself
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいった
findings.governingReading: Illya says Sakura went to confront and settle matters with her own existence as the Grail.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the confrontation into a decision to kill or end herself, before Illya’s next explicit claim about self-erasure.

findings.highlight: the Sakura you know
findings.evidenceJa: シロウが想ってるサクラ
findings.governingReading: The other self differs from the Sakura Shirou holds in his heart or loves.
findings.explanation: The English reduces his emotional attachment to acquaintance or knowledge.

findings.highlight: she’s talking about herself rather than about Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤという名を、サクラという響きに置き換えたもの
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears Illya’s own name beneath the sound of Sakura’s name in her argument.
findings.explanation: The English conveys self-reference but loses the precise name-and-sound substitution.

findings.highlight: That’s all I care about
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にはそれだけだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says this simple recognition is all he has as an answer.
findings.explanation: The English changes limited understanding into exclusive concern, implying other considerations do not matter.

findings.highlight: Illya stays standing in the hallway, as if seeing off something very far away
findings.evidenceJa: 遠くを見るように佇むイリヤ
findings.governingReading: Illya remains standing as though gazing into the distance.
findings.explanation: The English turns her distant gaze into seeing off an unspecified faraway object.

findings.highlight: tired from all the running
findings.evidenceJa: 朝から走り詰めで疲れている
findings.governingReading: Shirou should be tired from having run continuously since morning.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the starting time and uninterrupted duration.

findings.highlight: The floor creaks as I make my way to the stairs
findings.evidenceJa: ギシギシと音をたてて、二階への階段に足をかける
findings.governingReading: Shirou sets foot on the staircase to the second floor as it creaks.
findings.explanation: The English transfers the sound to the floor and places him only on the way to the stairs.

findings.highlight: the glass above the landing
findings.evidenceJa: 踊り場の天窓
findings.governingReading: The sky is visible through the skylight over the stair landing.
findings.explanation: The English removes the architectural identity of the skylight.

findings.highlight: a simple room suited for Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜らしい飾り気のない部屋
findings.governingReading: The room is unadorned in a way Shirou recognizes as characteristic of Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English makes the room merely suitable for her and weakens the characterization.
